passage: Of the 400 predictions in this 1990 book, these six came true, so clearly the author could see the future.

The study claiming sugary drinks don't contribute to obesity was funded by a beverage company that had the right to review results before publication. That doesn't make it wrong, but it's a reason to give more weight to independent studies on the same question.
This is Amina. She walks four hours a day to fetch water. $30 can give her family clean water for a year.
Drunk driving killed over 13,000 people last year. Each one was someone's parent, child, or friend. Plan a ride before you drink.
The author of this report on pesticide safety used to be a lobbyist for the pesticide's manufacturer, so I don't trust his conclusions.
The finance minister tells households to tighten their belts while she expensed $40,000 in first-class flights. Why should anyone take her austerity message seriously?
I met two people from Ohio on my trip and both were rude. People from Ohio just aren't friendly.
The committee's report was approved unanimously, so each member voted for it.
I've been an ER nurse for 20 years, and every full moon the ER gets busier.
This website has published dozens of fabricated stories that were later retracted, including invented quotes. I wouldn't treat its unsourced report as evidence until a reliable outlet confirms it.
Your argument for the vaccine schedule rested on an appeal to authority, which is a fallacy. So the vaccine schedule must be wrong.
A Nobel-winning physicist says the new nutrition guidelines rest on flawed statistics. That's worth taking seriously.
Every law has a lawmaker. The laws of physics are laws, so someone must have made them.

I got sick twice after eating at that taco truck. That's not proof and it could be coincidence, but I'm going to report it to the health department so they can check whether others had the same problem.
If the court lets police search a car without a warrant because the driver 'looked nervous,' that standard could justify searching almost anyone, since nearly everyone looks nervous when pulled over.
My grandfather smoked two packs a day and lived to 97, so smoking can't be that bad for you.
If we let students redo one exam, soon they'll expect to redo every assignment, then grades will mean nothing, and eventually diplomas will be worthless.
Movie poster: 'STUNNING!' - The Daily Ledger. (The review's actual sentence: 'It is stunning that a film this expensive could be this dull.')
Observational studies following 100,000 people found that moderate coffee drinkers live slightly longer, even after adjusting for smoking and income. So coffee probably extends life.
We've always voted on paper ballots at board meetings, so there's no reason to consider electronic voting now.

Comparing the national budget to a household budget is misleading here: a household can't issue its own currency or borrow at the government's rates, and those are exactly the differences that matter for whether deficits are sustainable.
My opponent says we should trim the military budget by 5%. Apparently she wants to leave the country defenseless against any invader.

After the U.S. raised the drinking age to 21, alcohol-related traffic deaths among 18-to-20-year-olds fell, and studies comparing states that changed their laws at different times found the same pattern. That's evidence the law saved lives.
Each player on our team is among the best in the league at their position, so we'll obviously be the best team in the league.
The university is world-famous, so every professor there must be world-class.

This bridge design has been used for over a century across thousands of installations with an excellent safety record. Absent a specific reason to think conditions here are different, it's a sensible default.
Professor, I deserve an A on this paper. I've been under so much stress this semester, and my parents will be crushed if I don't get one.
The pamphlet is trustworthy because it says it contains only verified facts, and anything that contains only verified facts is trustworthy.
The salesman says the car has never been in an accident, but he earns commission on the sale and won't show me the vehicle history report. I'll get an independent inspection before I believe him.
Employees are like nails: just as nails only work when you hit them on the head, employees only perform when you push them hard.
If the new software update were causing the crashes, we'd see more crash reports this week. We are seeing more crash reports this week. So the update is causing the crashes.
Countries with more Nobel laureates per capita also eat more chocolate per capita, so eating chocolate makes a population smarter.
Estimates of the project's cost range from $8 million to $14 million, and the two independent audits both came in near $11 million. Budgeting around $11 million with a contingency seems sensible.

When the state raised its cigarette tax by $1 a pack, youth smoking fell 15% over the next two years, while it stayed flat in neighboring states that didn't change their tax. That comparison suggests the tax contributed to the decline.
Humans can't have done this much damage to the oceans, because if we had, our whole way of life would have to change, and that's too depressing to accept.

If we accept the principle that any speech someone finds offensive should be banned from campus, then nearly every political view would be banned, since each one offends someone. Nobody here wants that, so the principle needs narrowing.
We shouldn't adopt the four-day school week: several studies of districts that tried it found measurable drops in math scores, and working parents would have to pay for an extra day of childcare.
Most economists surveyed say rent control reduces housing supply over time, so the city shouldn't adopt it.
All poets are creative people. No accountants are poets. Therefore no accountants are creative people.
This quote attributed to Lincoln first appears in a self-help book from the 1990s, with no source from his lifetime. That's good reason to think he never said it.
My mechanic, who has serviced this model for 15 years, says the noise is a worn wheel bearing. I'll go with her diagnosis unless the second shop sees something different.
We tried the new onboarding flow with 12 users and 11 of them finished signup faster. Let's roll it out.
The idea of a weekend comes from religious sabbath practices, so secular people have no reason to support having weekends off.
Seat belts don't prevent every death in a crash, so there's no point in requiring them.

Three neighboring cities lowered their rezoning approval threshold from a supermajority to a simple majority, and in each one variance requests rose 40 to 60 percent within two years. If we make the same change, we should expect a similar increase and budget planning staff accordingly.
The airport scanner is 99% accurate at flagging weapons, and it flagged this passenger, so there's a 99% chance he's carrying a weapon.
Either the printer is out of ink or the cable is unplugged. The printer is out of ink, so the cable must be plugged in.
Your new treatment claims to cure arthritis. Until there's a controlled trial, I'll assume it doesn't work.
No one has ever proven that the new cell towers are safe, so they must be what's causing the headaches people in our neighborhood report.
Before my opponent speaks, remember that he's a lawyer who'll say anything to win, so take whatever he's about to tell you with a grain of salt.
Why should we take Professor Hale's argument on tax policy seriously? She's been divorced three times and can't even manage her own life.

Requiring a license to fly a commercial drone makes sense for the same reason we license pilots of small aircraft: both share airspace with others, both can cause serious harm when mishandled, and in both cases training measurably reduces accidents.
This charity's board includes two people who were sanctioned for fraud at previous nonprofits. I'd be cautious about donating.
Supporters of stricter immigration enforcement say border processing should be faster and more orderly. In other words, they want to slam the door on every immigrant, period.
Seventy percent of residents voted against the new tax in the referendum, so the council should drop it.

You say the photo shows a ghost. A long exposure with someone walking through the frame produces exactly this kind of translucent figure, and the metadata shows a two-second exposure. Unless something can't be explained that way, it's the better explanation.
You'd better agree that the merger is a good idea. People who question the CEO's plans tend not to get promoted.
Before we abolish this decades-old rule, we should find out why it was introduced. Long-standing rules often encode lessons people have forgotten.
In a 12-week study of 300 adults, people using our toothpaste had 20% less plaque on average than people using a standard fluoride toothpaste. Individual results may vary.
All employees with admin access must complete security training. Dana has admin access. So Dana must complete security training.

The defense notes that the prosecution's key witness was offered a reduced sentence in exchange for his testimony and has a prior perjury conviction. The jury should weigh his account with that in mind, alongside the physical evidence.
A: No real fan of this team would ever boo the players. B: I've seen lifelong season-ticket holders boo. A: Well, then they're not real fans.

A random sample of 2,000 registered voters, weighted for age and region, found 58% support for the transit levy, with a margin of error of plus or minus 2 points. So most registered voters likely support it.
Over ten million people have switched to our energy drink. With that many fans, it has to be the healthiest choice on the market.
The court held in an earlier case that searching a locked phone requires a warrant. A locked tablet stores the same kinds of private data in the same way, so the same rule should apply.

We tested 500 widgets from five different production lines under the new process and found zero defects, compared with a 3% defect rate before. The new process looks like an improvement, though we'll keep monitoring.

The screening test has a 1% false-positive rate, but the disease affects only 1 in 10,000 people. So most positive results in the general population will be false positives, and a positive screen should be confirmed with a second test.
The burglary-prevention program was piloted in twelve districts and burglaries rose overall, but supporters point to the three districts where they fell and say those show the program works.
We don't know the long-term effects of kids spending six or more hours a day on social media, so parents should limit it.
We scanned all server logs for the past 90 days and found no login attempts from outside the company network. So it's unlikely the breach came through an external login.

The prosecution hasn't presented any evidence placing the defendant at the scene. Since the burden of proof is on the state, the jury should acquit, not because innocence has been proven, but because guilt hasn't.
He struck the attacker only after the attacker pulled a knife and lunged at him. Using force to stop an imminent threat is legally and morally different from starting a fight.

The ballot measure will either pass or fail. If it passes, the county has to find $12 million in the existing budget; if it fails, the library branches close in June. Either way, the council needs a plan before June.
The Supreme Court has ruled on this exact question, so as a matter of current law, the policy is permitted.
This supplement is made from 100% natural herbs, so it can't have any harmful side effects.
I started wearing my lucky socks on game days and the team has won three straight. The socks are clearly working.
Councilmember, have you stopped wasting taxpayer money on vanity projects?

Satellite, ocean-buoy, and land-station temperature records, maintained by different agencies in different countries, all show about 1.1 degrees C of warming since pre-industrial times. Agreement across independent methods is strong evidence the warming is real.

Senator Ruiz says this bill is unconstitutional because it delegates too much power to an agency, yet last year she co-sponsored a bill with nearly identical delegation language. She should explain what distinguishes the two.

Reporter: Did your department go over budget this year? Official: What I can tell you is that our team has worked incredibly hard, and public safety is something every family in this city cares about.

The drop in bee populations in our county coincides with increased use of neonicotinoid pesticides. That correlation alone doesn't prove causation, but given lab studies showing these pesticides impair bee navigation, it's a plausible hypothesis worth a controlled field study.

In deciding the sentence, the judge should consider that the defendant cares for two disabled siblings and has no prior record. These facts don't bear on guilt, but they're relevant to what punishment is proportionate.

Every major medical body, from the WHO to the national academies of dozens of countries, has concluded that the MMR vaccine does not cause autism, based on studies covering millions of children. Unless you have evidence of comparable quality, the reasonable position is to accept that conclusion.
Everyone in the department has to submit receipts for reimbursement, except me; I'm the director and I'm busy.
One engineer says the bridge can safely hold 20 tons; another says it will fail above 10. Let's split the difference and post a 15-ton limit.
Once the city let one food truck set up on Main Street, three more applied within a month. If we approve this next one, we'll probably have a row of them blocking the sidewalks by summer.
Either we ban all cars from downtown, or we accept that the air will keep getting worse. There's no in-between.
Every billionaire founder I've read about dropped out of college, so dropping out must be a smart move for aspiring entrepreneurs.
Sure, I padded my expense report, but the company underpays everyone, so it evens out.
The so-called 'tax relief' bill hands the biggest breaks to the wealthiest 1%.
A famous Olympic swimmer says this cryptocurrency is the safest investment around, so it's a safe place for your retirement savings.
You've never run a business, so you're not in a position to criticize small-business regulations.
The kitchen floor is wet, the dishwasher door is open, and water is spreading from underneath it. The most likely explanation is that the dishwasher is leaking.

Last winter, four people died of exposure within a block of this shelter after it closed at 9 p.m. Keeping it open overnight in freezing weather would cost about $40,000 a season. Those deaths should weigh on us, because they were preventable.
Naturally the dentists' association says regular cleanings prevent gum disease; its members get paid for cleanings. So we can ignore that advice.

Breast milk contains antibodies that formula can't currently replicate, and studies controlling for income find lower rates of some infections in breastfed infants. That's a reason to support breastfeeding where possible, while formula remains a safe alternative.
Humans evolved eating meat, so a diet that includes meat is appropriate for us.

This new additive hasn't been tested for safety in infants. Until it has, it shouldn't go into infant formula, not because it's known to be harmful, but because the burden is on the manufacturer to show it's safe.
Nine of the ten engineers who reviewed the design independently flagged the same weld joint as a weak point. We should re-examine that joint before approving the plans.
If you study medicine, you'll have a stable career. You're not studying medicine, so you won't have a stable career.

As I understand your proposal, you want to raise the minimum wage to $18 over four years, with a lower rate for businesses under 20 employees. My concern is the carve-out: it gives firms an incentive to stay just under 20 employees.
That economic proposal was praised by a dictator, so anyone who supports it is basically siding with tyranny.
We've already spent $3 million on this software project. The consultants say it will never work, but we can't stop now or all that money will be wasted.
I just can't see how something as complex as the eye could have come about through gradual steps, so it can't have evolved.
This restaurant has a 4.7-star average from over 3,000 reviews, so it's probably good.
Everyone who took part in the burglary had a key card for the building. Mark had a key card for the building. So Mark was one of the burglars.
The union wants a 6% raise and management is offering 2%, so a 4% raise is the fair outcome.

A: Show me one peer-reviewed study that supports this. B: Here are three. A: Three studies isn't enough; show me a meta-analysis. B: Here's one. A: Meta-analyses can be biased; I'd need a decade of real-world results.
The roulette wheel has landed on red eight times in a row, so black is due. I'm putting everything on black.
Critics say the $200 million stadium subsidy is wasteful. If cost per daily user is the test, they should apply it to the $350 million highway interchange too, which serves fewer people.
If interest rates keep rising, mortgage payments for new buyers will rise too, since payments are calculated directly from the rate. That will likely cool demand in the housing market.

If we grant this late application with no stated reason, every future late applicant can cite it, and our bylaws say past decisions bind future ones. So if we grant it, we should write down the specific circumstances that justify it.
Jaywalking and armed robbery are both crimes, so a candidate who once jaywalked is no more trustworthy than one convicted of robbery.
If the backup had run last night, there would be a file timestamped after midnight in the archive folder. There isn't one. So the backup did not run.
Your argument uses 'theory' in two senses. In science it means a well-tested explanatory framework, not a guess, so calling evolution 'just a theory' doesn't show it's uncertain.
You said no mammals lay eggs. The platypus and echidnas are mammals, and they lay eggs, so the claim is false as stated.
Every brick in this wall weighs about 2 kg, and there are 500 bricks, so the wall weighs roughly a ton.
My doctor told me to quit smoking, but she's overweight herself, so I don't see why I should listen to her.

In a randomized trial of 12,000 participants, those assigned the drug had 25% fewer heart attacks than those on placebo over five years, and two independent trials replicated the result. That's good evidence the drug reduces heart-attack risk.
We shouldn't hire this candidate as treasurer: he was convicted of embezzling from his last two employers.
